concepts.simple_definition: 8.1 Economy and the Environment 183 UNIT 8: ECONOMY, ENVIRONMENT AND CLIMATE CHANGE The fundamental principle of economic theory argues that economic resources are scarce in a sense that they are in finite quantities, whereas the claims to which these resources are put are at least to a reasonable extent limitless
concepts.deep_explanation: The scarcity of resources implies that their use is costly and results in an opportunity cost
